name: Whippet
flavor: Zero to zoomies in under a second.

name: Shetland Sheepdog
flavor: Herds the joggers, gently, whether they like it or not.

name: Australian Shepherd
flavor: Needs a job. Will invent one if you do not.

name: Havanese
flavor: A silky little clown who loves an audience.

name: Scottish Terrier
flavor: Walks like it owns a castle.

name: Cairn Terrier
flavor: Tough little rock-hopper with a shaggy fringe.

name: Shiba Inu
flavor: Dramatic. Independent. Screams at bath time.

name: Basenji
flavor: Does not bark. Yodels instead.

name: Bull Terrier
flavor: Egg-shaped head, clownish heart.

name: Staffordshire Bull Terrier
flavor: All muscle, all smiles, all kisses.

name: Papillon
flavor: Ears like butterfly wings, mind like a whip.

name: Italian Greyhound
flavor: A greyhound shrunk in the wash. Still fast.

name: Miniature Pinscher
flavor: The self-appointed king of the dog run.

name: Lhasa Apso
flavor: A monastery watchdog in a floor-length coat.

name: Pekingese
flavor: Rolls like a mop with a lion's pride.

name: Keeshond
flavor: Wears its spectacles at all times.

name: Old English Sheepdog
flavor: Can it see? Nobody knows. It finds the ball anyway.

name: Bloodhound
flavor: Can smell a sandwich from the next park over.

name: Brittany
flavor: A pocket rocket of a bird dog.

name: English Springer Spaniel
flavor: Springs out of the long grass like popcorn.

name: Vizsla
flavor: A velcro dog the colour of autumn leaves.

name: Weimaraner
flavor: The grey ghost of the duck pond.

name: Pointer
flavor: Freezes mid-step whenever a pigeon lands.

name: Irish Setter
flavor: Red silk feathers, one brain cell, pure joy.

name: English Setter
flavor: Freckled like a speckled egg.

name: Collie
flavor: Elegant, loyal, and always checking on you.

name: Dalmatian
flavor: Has exactly the right number of spots.

name: Bernedoodle
flavor: Mountain dog muscles in a poodle perm.

name: Cavapoo
flavor: A curly sweetheart sized for any lap.

name: Fluffy Corgi
flavor: A long-coat corgi. The fluff is unregulated.

name: Blue Merle Corgi
flavor: Marbled like a thunderstorm on short legs.

name: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier
flavor: Greets everybody with the famous wheaten spin.

name: Blue Merle Aussie
flavor: One blue eye, one brown eye, both on the ball.

name: Lemon Pointer
flavor: A pointer splashed with lemon drops.

name: Brindle Whippet
flavor: Tiger-striped and twice as quick.

name: English Cocker Spaniel
flavor: Blue roan coat, tail never stops.

name: Wire Fox Terrier
flavor: A bearded little sprinter.

name: Smooth Fox Terrier
flavor: Built for speed and mischief.

name: Norwich Terrier
flavor: Small, brave and permanently curious.

name: Toy Fox Terrier
flavor: A fox terrier with the volume turned down.

name: Dandie Dinmont Terrier
flavor: Topknot like a powder puff.

name: Skye Terrier
flavor: Hair to the floor, ears to the sky.

name: Sealyham Terrier
flavor: A low white terrier with a grand beard.

name: Pocket Beagle
flavor: Fits in a pocket. Empties the pocket.

name: Chow Chow
flavor: A lion with a blue tongue and a dignified stare.

name: Lemon Basset
flavor: Droopy, drowsy and dreamy.

name: Mastiff
flavor: A gentle mountain that drools.

name: Bullmastiff
flavor: Night watchman. Day napper.

name: Boxador
flavor: Boxer bounce, lab appetite.

name: Sprocker Spaniel
flavor: Springer meets cocker. Pure wiggle.

name: Aussiedoodle
flavor: Curly coat, herding brain, endless questions.

name: Cavachon
flavor: Soft as a scone, sweet as jam.

name: Airedale Terrier
flavor: The king of terriers, and it knows it.

name: Beaglier
flavor: Beagle nose, cavalier manners.

name: Jogging Trail Jack
flavor: Laps the runners, then laps them again.

name: Duck Pond Doodle
flavor: Gets in the pond every single time.

name: Picnic Pug
flavor: Has eaten your sandwich. Will deny it.

name: Kite Collie
flavor: Watches the kites and tries to herd them.

name: Leaf Pile Basset
flavor: Dives into every leaf pile. Comes out wearing it.

name: Fountain Frenchie
flavor: Bites at the fountain spray until it is soaked.

name: Bandstand Beagle
flavor: Howls along with the brass band.

name: Gazebo Greyhound
flavor: Naps in the gazebo shade like a statue.

name: Tulip Terrier
flavor: Rolls in the flowerbeds. Smells amazing.

name: Seesaw Shiba
flavor: Rides the seesaw alone. Somehow it still works.

name: Bench Warmer Bulldog
flavor: Saves your spot on the park bench.

name: Lamp Post Lab
flavor: Waits under the lamp post for evening walkies.

name: Hopscotch Havanese
flavor: Hops every square in the right order.

name: Headphone Whippet
flavor: Jogs to its own playlist.

name: Birdwatcher Beagle
flavor: Has logged every pigeon in the park.

name: Scarf Setter
flavor: Scarf flowing, feathers flowing, tongue flowing.

name: Flower Crown Papillon
flavor: Wears the park's best daisies.

name: Ballcap Corgi
flavor: Little league mascot and unpaid umpire.

name: Backpack Boxer
flavor: Carries your snacks. Eats your snacks.

name: Ranger Retriever
flavor: Patrols the trails and reports every squirrel.

name: Duchess Petunia
flavor: Holds court on the picnic blanket. Snacks are tribute.

name: Sage Acornelius
flavor: Lectures squirrels on the theory of acorns.

name: Marshal Pinecrest
flavor: Keeps law and order on the jogging trail.

name: Rootwarden
flavor: Older than the oldest oak, and twice as patient.

name: Moonpuddle
flavor: Only seen at dusk, splashing through moon reflections.

name: Oakenwing
flavor: The park's guardian stag-hound, gliding over the treetops.
